review_evidence: This AFP hash-partition contains 457 primary Isabelle theories; 428 contain 17,259 theorem/definition/function/datatype/locale/class-family declarations under a broad structural scan.

The partition spans independent Archive of Formal Proofs entries in automata, cryptography, finite fields, program semantics, logic, analysis, verification, and supporting formal libraries; declaration-light theories include import roots, examples/tests, generated-code checks, setup, and entry presentation modules.

Inspection of the declaration-light Go code-generation theory Generate.thy shows that test-like naming can still carry formal code-generation/checking semantics; blanket test/example/import exclusion would therefore lose useful prior-art signals and no lossless common selector was found.
summary: Retain AFP thys hash-partition c in full as substantive Isabelle formalization content.
